label: Deriving weak esse adequacy for participants from independently valued intrinsic determinations
summary:
The route 8fe13407 reaches aba6f4e1 for the same selected actual giver and every actual participant. It shares eeb89ffe and 50da2b49 with dcec5717 and replaces its unrestricted 87f41688 with two open assumptions. 191395d0 preserves in the giver every pure determination of that recipient in the selected inventory. 6ab848a8 calibrates the bearer's own esse degree to the least upper bound of its realized levels. Neither d5a94eb1 nor a strongest realized item, total ordering or strict superiority occurs. Relative to the earlier e3167aef repertoire test, universal source completeness is unnecessary, and the correspondence with the represented degree is explicit. An empty inventory or constant calibration can make degrees tie and does not warrant a discriminating actual scale. A two-port routing control tests the common inference that all supplied content must bound every local intensity: passing each positive count separately conserves total and peak, whereas concentrating the same counts in one port conserves the total but increases the peak and crosses an independently fixed local threshold. The mechanism concerns supplied quantities, with no actual metaphysical reversal asserted. Actual unity supplies a common existential determination on the stipulated reading, but no rich scale; an organism's immanent self-maintenance has identifiable intrinsic content, but producing it does not establish its immanent analogue in the giver or its level as esse. The positive reason for a weak adequacy premise is sharing a perfection which the giver itself realizes; this has conditional warrant within that reading. Neither the productive reading of eminence nor a mere difference in subsistence mode supplies this calibration. See docs/notes/maximum-definition-fork.md, section 'When does what is communicated fix the giver’s own degree of esse?'.

blocker: The general Cartesian proposition and the two application premises remain open. Reopen intrinsic calibration on evidence for a grade-bearing actuality identifiable independently in the source and the participant, with argument for its cross-mode ordering as esse and for completeness against joint or modal differences.
